topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Oh, I can't even imagine what must be going through your heads right now. This house, it's not just bricks and mortar, it's where all those memories lived. I mean, think about it, the place where you learned to ride your bikes, where you had those endless summer barbecues. And now, you two are in charge of it. What must it feel like to suddenly hold all that in your hands? I know it’s not just exciting, there’s so much more tangled up in it. But hey, you’ve got each other, and that’s something solid, something that’s always been there, you know? Just take it one step at a time, okay? I’m here, just a call away. We’ll figure it out together.
